race.comment: PROCHESTER (2) sets up a treat after saluting in a CL3 at this track as an odds-on favourite at the latest. Third-up now and already proven at the trip, he's the one to beat. OUTBURST (9) is the main danger after BM78 second at Eagle Farm, where he improved sharply second-up to only miss the winner by 0.7L despite being held up near the 150m. Has won here before and another strong showing is likely. GOLDEN SMILE (10) brings a reliable place-heavy profile and comes off a CL2 second at this venue, with the weight relief a genuine asset. CASTELLO GRANDE (8) had excuses when wide and hampered behind PROCHESTER last start, and his 1800m record gives him a route back into the placings. With improvement to come third-up he's another live chance.
